_about:
data/vanilla_sha256.json: the SHA-256 of every game file a seed may change (each file any built patch under out/
wrote, plus the size table and text), read as vanilla (./original copies win over the live romfs). Hashes only, no game
content. romtools.Romfs checks a live file against it before reading it as vanilla, so a game folder that already holds
another seed (a randomizer folder that lost its install record) or another game version is refused instead of being
patched on top of.
